column1: # references.tsv --- the source trees this project reviews and verifies against.
# Fetched by scripts/fetch-references.sh into a per-host cache OUTSIDE the
# repository, one directory per name-version, shared read-only by every
# Why these versions: they are the ones actually in use, measured 2026-09-30,
#   emacs 30.2      nexus, FreeBSD 15.1 -- where the skills were verified
#   emacs e8d708a   this Mac's development build (32.0.50)
#   guile 3.0.10    nexus and this Mac -- verified-on in every SKILL.md
#   guile 3.0.11    current stable (Homebrew), not yet verified against
#   geiser, geiser-guile   latest tags; ELPA snapshots here are 20260718 / 20260516
#   emacs-arei, guile-ares-rs   the nREPL alternative under evaluation
# kind: tar  -> sha256 of the downloaded archive (pinned; a mismatch is fatal).
#               Each was first checked against its GNU .sig with gnu-keyring.gpg
#               (2026-09-30: all five "Good signature"), so the pin is not TOFU.
#       git  -> the COMMIT the tag resolves to (the peeled ^{} value, not an
#               annotated tag object -- that mistake failed the first run)
